title: Exact functors carry natural transformations and projection squares to unbounded derived categories
statement: Let $C_i$ be abelian categories with unbounded derived categories, and let all functors below be additive and exact [lem-weil-pbc-localization-universal-property]. A natural transformation $\tau:F\to F'$ has a specified image $D\tau:DF\to DF'$ obtained degreewise on complexes and descended using the canonical exact-functor factorization isomorphisms. This construction preserves identities, composition, isomorphism maps and both whiskerings, with the canonical composition isomorphisms inserted. In particular, take $E:C_0\to C_1$, $P:C_1\to C_2$, $J:C_0\to C_2$, $H:C_0\to C_3$, $E':C_3\to C_4$, $P':C_4\to C_5$, $J':C_3\to C_5$, $G:C_1\to C_4$, $T:C_2\to C_5$, isomorphisms $\sigma:EG\simeq HE'$, $\theta:GP'\simeq PT$, $j:HJ'\simeq JT$, and transformations $\delta:EP\to J$, $\delta':E'P'\to J'$. If $(\sigma P');(H\delta');j=(E\theta);(\delta T)$, with associators inserted, the corresponding equation holds after $D$, using the specified exact composition and square comparisons. No boundedness hypothesis is imposed.

lean.statement:
theorem mapDerivedCategoryNatTrans_projectionSquare
    (σ : E ⋙ G ≅ H ⋙ E') (θ : G ⋙ P' ≅ P ⋙ T) (j : H ⋙ J' ≅ J ⋙ T)
    (δ : E ⋙ P ⟶ J) (δ' : E' ⋙ P' ⟶ J')
    (hδ : Functor.whiskerRight σ.hom P' ≫ (Functor.associator H E' P').hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft H δ' ≫ j.hom =
      (Functor.associator E G P').hom ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft E θ.hom ≫
        (Functor.associator E P T).inv ≫ Functor.whiskerRight δ T)
    (K : DerivedCategory C₀) :
    P'.mapDerivedCategory.map ((mapDerivedCategorySquareIso σ).hom.app K) ≫
        (mapDerivedCategoryCompIso E' P').inv.app (H.mapDerivedCategory.obj K) ≫
        (mapDerivedCategoryNatTrans δ').app (H.mapDerivedCategory.obj K) ≫
        (mapDerivedCategorySquareIso j).hom.app K =
      (mapDerivedCategorySquareIso θ).hom.app (E.mapDerivedCategory.obj K) ≫
        T.mapDerivedCategory.map ((mapDerivedCategoryCompIso E P).inv.app K ≫
          (mapDerivedCategoryNatTrans δ).app K)
